mapper.select: SELECT vm.voice_model_id, vm.voice_asset_id, vm.ref_id, vm.model_version, vm.model_storage_key, vm.prompt, vm.similarity_score, vm.status, vm.is_deleted, vm.deleted_at, vm.create_time, vm.update_time FROM voice_model vm INNER JOIN voice_asset va ON vm.voice_asset_id = va.voice_asset_id WHERE va.owner_user_id = #{userId, typeHandler=com.echoes.voice.domain.voice.repository.typehandler.UUIDTypeHandler} AND va.name = #{voiceName} AND va.is_deleted = 0 AND vm.is_deleted = 0 AND vm.status = 'success' ORDER BY vm.model_version DESC, vm.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
